description: 尼姆佐-印度 E43 — 利用d5弱格建立马据点

intro.popup_en: Using the Weak Square on d5, Lesson 5: White's f3-e4 setup is designed to support a knight on d5. Black's ...c5 and ...d6 structure leaves that square available. White's goal is to create the weakness and then occupy it with Nd5.
intro.popup:
利用d5弱格 第5课

f3+e4组合专门为d5弱格服务
黑方c5+d6布局留下d5空档

白方目标：Nd5占据最强弱格
弱格不会自动产生—需要主动创造！

outro.popup_en: After bxc3, White accepts doubled pawns in exchange for a weak d5-square. The f3-e4 setup supports the plan, and after e4 advances White can occupy d5 with a knight. First create the weakness, then occupy it.
outro.popup:
建立马据点小结
✅ bxc3后虽有叠兵，但换来d5弱格
✅ f3+e4撑起d5弱格框架
✅ e4推进后Nd5将进驻弱格

核心原则：
先制造弱格，再占据弱格！

moves.popup_en: d4 controls the center.
...Nf6 develops a knight.
c4 expands on the queenside.
...e6 prepares the Nimzo-Indian setup.
Nc3 develops a knight.
...Bb4! Black pins the knight in the Nimzo-Indian.
e3 preserves the bishop pair and chooses a steadier line than Qc2.
moves.popup:
e3保留双象
选择比Qc2更平稳的变例

moves.popup_en: ...b6 prepares ...Bb7 and develops the bishop on the long diagonal.
moves.popup:
b6准备Bb7
黑方建立长斜线

moves.popup_en: Bd3 develops, supports e4, and targets h7.
...Bb7 places the dark-squared bishop on the long diagonal toward g2.
moves.popup:
Bb7建立长对角线
黑格象射向g2方向

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops a knight.
...O-O castles.
O-O secures White's king.
...c5! Black challenges d4. The ...c5-d6 structure leaves d5 without a pawn defender.
moves.popup:
c5冲击！
黑方挑战d4
注意：c5+d6布局让d5格空档

moves.popup_en: a3 challenges the bishop and invites the exchange.
Bxc3 exchanges the light-squared bishop.
bxc3 creates doubled pawns, but in return White has created a weak square on d5.
moves.popup:
bxc3叠兵
代价是叠兵，收益是d5弱格！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 defends, but the c5-d6 pawn formation still leaves d5 as a gap.
Nd2! White reorganizes the knight toward f1-e3, preparing to occupy the weak square on d5.
moves.popup:
Nd2重组！
马准备走到f1-e3路线
目标是Nd5弱格据点

moves.popup_en: ...Nbd7 develops and keeps Black's structure solid.
moves.popup:
Nbd7发展马
黑方阵型稳固

moves.popup_en: f3! White supports the e4 advance and restricts Black's knight from jumping to e4.
moves.popup:
f3加强！
为e4推进铺路
同时限制黑马跳e4

moves.popup_en: ...Rc8 reinforces Black's c-file.
e4! White advances, and d5 is now completely free of Black pawn control. White can maneuver a knight to d5 by routes such as Nd2-b1-c3-d5 or Nf1-e3-d5. The outpost is ready to be established.
moves.popup:
e4推进！
d5格完全脱离黑兵守护
下一步：Nd2-Nb1-Nc3-Nd5或Nf1-Ne3-Nd5
弱格据点即将建立！
